newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China tricksters work magic on wallets.
newsitem.headline: China tricksters work magic on wallets.

text.p: Two conmen posing as masters of an ancient Chinese mystic belief called qigong fleeced a crowd of onlookers who handed over money to prove their faith, a Chinese newspaper reported on Monday.

The two men told a crowd that gathered in the southern Chinese boom town of Shenzhen to show their faith in qigong by putting their money on the ground in front of them, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily newspaper said.

The men, one of whom claimed to have been trained at a famous temple, then told the crowd that if they did not turn around and take 20 steps away they would all be immobilised by the qigong energy radiating from the two, the newspaper said.
The two men then grabbed the money and ran away, it said. It did not say how much money they took.
Qigong is a widely practiced Chinese theory of inner energy.
